features: [GaN technology] It ensures higher efficiency in a smaller form factor, fitting easily in pockets or bags. The adapter operates cooler and charges faster, with enhanced heat resistance reducing energy loss and preventing overheating.
[Low standby power] Its low-standby power (0.005W) minimizes energy waste when plugged in, reducing electricity consumption without altering user habits.

[USB Power Delivery 3.1] The adapter supports USB Power Delivery 3.1 with PPS (Programmable Power Supply) for universal compatibility and intelligent power delivery, optimizing charging speed while safeguarding battery health.
[Supports Multiple Devices] The adapter supports charging of multiple devices like smartphone, laptop and tablet. It delivers 75% charge in 30 minutes for Galaxy S26 Ultra smartphone.
[Recycled Material] It incorporates 20% recycled material and is UL certified, appealing to environmentally conscious buyers.
description: 60W Super fast charging 2.0 | GaN (Gallium Nitride) technology | Low-standby power (0.005W)
